issues.description: Attribute type mismatch for the bitmap pixel buffer: in the template repository the Bitmap24 class declares the member 'data' as 'int *data' (Bitmap24.hpp) but the implementation (Bitmap24.cpp) allocates and uses it as a char array (new char[...], indexed and assigned with char values). The solution repository uses 'char *data' in the header (matching the implementation). This mismatch in the template will cause compilation/type errors (assigning char* to int* and incompatible indexing/assignments) and will confuse or block students working from the template.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the member declaration in the template header to match the implementation and the solution: replace 'int *data;' with 'char *data;' (or use 'unsigned char *' if you prefer explicitly unsigned pixel bytes). Update the comment to note 3 bytes per pixel. This preserves the pedagogical intent while fixing the compilation/type error.
